summary: Added --workspace <file> to `vloop metrics` and `vloop metrics export`: a TOML file of [[repo]] tables (path relative to the file, optional name) gives a table with a leading repo column, or concatenated exports with repo.name overridden; missing or non-git paths print one stderr line each and exit 1 after the rest is reported; --workspace with briefs is exit 2.
verified: The task's verify command: prints 'gate T6 ok' (gofmt, vet, tidy, linux/windows builds, go test ./internal/... ./cmd/vloop, and the fixture checks all pass).
notes: Export body moved into exportRepoLines(g,out,root,name,args); the metrics table is metrics.PrintWorkspaceTable, sharing printBriefTable with PrintBriefTable. A repo counts as a git repository when <path>/.git exists (dir or file); a plain directory inside another repo is therefore not found. The unnamed repo column uses repoIdentity(root).Name (origin basename, else directory name). Missing paths are reported on stderr directly and the command returns Problem(errors.New('')) (empty message: Execute prints nothing more, exits 1). --workspace with --json emits the concatenated reports array without a repo field. A relative workspace file path honors -C. README stays at 193 lines.
